title: Prosper breakfast @ The Old Sessions House (London) — Eric Ries in conversation with Nick Perrett on Incorruptible
summary: UK-tour Day 4 breakfast: Eric joins Prosper co-founder Nick Perrett for a morning conversation about Incorruptible at The Old Sessions House in Clerkenwell, London. Multiple attendee recaps within hours — CMO Hattie Moll ('Corruption breaks the logic of capitalism itself'), Andrew Olley ('a must read for businesses of all shapes and sizes'), Seyi Ayinla ('the best thing a founder can do is listen'), Stewart Bewley ('deeply refreshing and amazing'), and physician Dana Mincer among them.
blockquote: Corruption breaks the logic of capitalism itself.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries at the Prosper breakfast (via Hattie Moll)
attribution_title: The Old Sessions House, Clerkenwell, London · Sept 10 morning
